Regulatory pressure mounts as German authorities reject Bitcoin.de’s MiCA application and a lawsuit targets Tether, while the Winklevoss‑backed Zcash ETF seeks SEC approval. New token listings on Delta India add fresh liquidity but may be overshadowed by the prevailing downside.
